bibliographic.author: Martin Heidegger
bibliographic.title: Das Realitätsproblem in der modernen Philosophie
bibliographic.genre: critical review article and programmatic epistemological intervention

extracted_text.method: Poppler pdftotext -layout over the pinned journal archive PDF
extracted_text.normalization: Input bytes remain unchanged for fixity; analysis view joins OCR line wraps, removes soft hyphens and preserves page boundaries.

access_policy.basis: User-directed analysis of the journal's public article archive. No reusable full-text licence is inferred; release output is limited to hashes, locators, short lexical signals, statistics and original paraphrase.

crosswalk.target_edition: Martin Heidegger Gesamtausgabe 1, Frühe Schriften, 2nd ed. 2018
crosswalk.target_locator: GA 1, pp. 1–15; exact paragraph-by-paragraph page alignment remains unverified except the opening on GA 1 p. 1
crosswalk.note: The original publication is the analytic source. GA pagination is a work-level crosswalk, not a substitute for an edition-resolved textual locator.
